Today’s 9to5Toys Lunch Break is headlined by Apple’s most affordable bang for your buck M5 MacBook Air at nearly $200 off (Amazon low, all colors) as well as a Rare deal on this 32GB/1TB model. Alongside Amazon delivering all MacBook Neo models by tomorrow from $590, we also have Apple’s current-gen base iPad down at $299 while clearance pricing lands on the mid-range 512GB M3 iPad Air at $350 off, Apple’s most affordable AirPods 4 at nearly 25% off, and official Apple Solo Loops from $9 each. Head below for a closer look at the details.

Amazon delivering all base MacBook Neo models as early as tomorrow from $590, still up to 2 weeks from Apple

  • MacBook Neo Citrus 256GB $590 – $10 off w/ delivery by tomorrow
  • MacBook Neo Citrus 512GB $690 – $10 off w/ delivery by tomorrow
  • MacBook Neo Silver 256GB $590 – $10 off w/ delivery by tomorrow

  • MacBook Neo Blush 512GB $690 – $10 off w/ delivery by tomorrow

Apple’s most affordable bang for your buck M5 MacBook Air is nearly $200 off this week (Amazon low, all colors)

We have seen some retailers getting quite competitive on the upgraded and 15-inch M5 MacBook Air. But, after Apple upped the base storage tier to 512GB this generation, the most affordable 13-inch model is more compelling than ever and Amazon has the best price at $199 off the list right now on all four colors.

Amazon is currently offering the most affordable M5 MacBook Air you can buy down at $899.99 shipped.

Regularly $1,099, this is $199 off the list price and the best we have tracked to date at Amazon or otherwise. Some of the best authorized Apple dealers can get quite competitive with Amazon on new MacBook releases, much like B&H is right now on these 15-inch models at up to $270 off the list prices:

  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB $1,249 (Reg. $1,519)
  • With 35W Dual USB-C Port Compact Power Adapter (worth $20)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/512GB $1,249 (Reg. $1,519)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB $1,499 (Reg. $1,719)
  • With 70W USB-C Port Compact Power Adapter (worth $20)

But when it comes to the most affordable models in the lineup, Amazon tends to deliver the lowest prices, much like it is right now:

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB from $900 (Reg. $1,099) – Amazon all-time low

B&H is charging $1,049 for this machine and Best Buy is charging $949.

While in years past the base model MacBook Air models left something to be desired, first with the entirely underwhelming 8GB of RAM on the M3 model, and then with the thankfully defunct 256GB storage capacity on the M4. But with the 2026 M5 lineup, Apple has, in my opinion, hit the sweet spot when it comes to price and power on the entry model. Yes, the base model did go up in price this year, but you are landing a solid 16GB of RAM and the 512GB storage capacity that is just right for most users (and still for less than that config on previous models). Sure, everyone wants the 24GB+ RAM and 1TB+ in storage, but most folks probably don’t need it, nor the $1,499 price tag to get it either (this model is currently $1,299.99 at Amazon right now though).

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB from $1,100 (Reg. $1,299) – Amazon all-time low
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB from $1,300 (Reg. $1,499) – Amazon all-time low
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/512GB from $1,100 (Reg. $1,299) – Amazon all-time low
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 16GB/1TB from $1,300 (Reg. $1,499) – Amazon all-time low
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air 24GB/1TB from $1,500 (Reg. $1,699) – Amazon all-time low

Rare deal knocks $200 off this 32GB/1TB M5 MacBook Air you can’t buy at Amazon

The deals are flying this week on the new 2026 M5 MacBook Air, with $199 off the most affordable models you can buy, as much as $270 off select 15-inch configs, and we just spotted a chance to score a rare $200 price drop on a 32GB model you can’t buy at Amazon.

For folks looking to take it up a notch, and considering Amazon doesn’t even carry a 32GB M5 MacBook Air, we wanted to make sure this B&H deal on the 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 32GB of RAM and the 1TB SSD down at $1,499 shipped was on your radar.

Regularly $1,699, this is a straight up $200 off the list price and the best we can find. All things considered, and especially because Amazon and the big box retailers don’t carry this config, deals on this one will otherwise be hard to come by.

Land a new set of Apple’s most affordable AirPods 4 for the summer at nearly 25% off

Giant price drops hit official Apple Solo Loops today: One from $15, multi-packs from $9 each (Orig. up to $99 each)

Woot is back again today with another notable sale event on official Apple Watch silicone and braided Solo Loops. While we have been tracking these things starting down at just $15 for some time at Woot – they were originally as much as $99, today it is offering even deeper deals when you buy more than one – you can get the price down as low as $9 per band here.

There are two legacy Apple Watch bands on tap here, the silicone Solo Loop at $14.99 and the Braided Solo Loop at $29.99. Originally $49 and $99, respectively, this is already a wild price drop. But the per band price drops even lower when you buy more than one today:

  • Buy 2 and get an extra 15% off
  • Buy 3 and get an extra 30% off
  • Buy 4 or more and get an extra 40% off

This can yield a price as low as $9 per band with free shipping on all orders for Prime members to deliver one of the best deals we have tracked on these bands.

You’ll just want to pay attention to the size options on the main landing page, and then choose your style, color, and case size once you click through from the pull down menus.

Apple’s current-gen base iPad is down at $299 shipped on Amazon today

Arguably the best iPad you can buy for young kids, if not just because it won’t cost a fortune, the iPad 11 can also just be a great low-cost option for anyone when it comes to casual use, road trips, or just as a couch browser around the house. It is also one you can land down at $299 on Amazon right now in most colors.

Amazon has Apple’s current-generation 11-inch iPad (A16) sitting down at $299 shipped right now in Blue, Pink, and Silver – the Yellow model is a touch higher at $319, but we recommend waiting until it is at most $299 before pulling the trigger.

We have caught this deal a few times this year at least, but have yet to see it drop any lower than this since the holiday season last year when it feel an additional $25 or so on select colors.

While the A16-powered machine might seem underwhelming for those with cash to spend on an iPad Air or better, and there is no Apple Intelligence action on this model, it can, again, make for a great low-cost option for casual users. The iPad mini might, perhaps, be better for young kids as it can be a little bit easier to get their hands around it, but at 11-inches, this thing isn’t huge and gives them a whole lot more screen real estate when it comes to educational content, games, and watching shows.

If it is the iPad Air you’re after, scope out the clearance deals on the previous-gen M3 at up to $350 off– this can be a notable option for the slightly older kids and those who just don’t need the latest chip – as well as the newer M4 price drops you’ll find waiting down below:
